name: number-date-formats
body: `number` and `date` fields have named display formats defined by the template author plus a `default_format`. Formats govern rendering only: authors always write values as plain YAML numbers (e.g. `1250000`, `0.12`) and `YYYY-MM-DD` dates. The deck author picks a format via a sibling `<field>_format` field; the `_format` suffix is reserved. Unknown format name = error listing valid ones; omitted = default_format.
